citations.review_text: Game is absolutely oozing with charm and the art style and music is spot on. not to mention the gameplay once you start getting mastery of the flow and levels is addicting. Worth the price of a large pizza

Incredible level design and tight momentum-based controls make this a blast to play. Wario Land 4 was my 1st and favorite Nintendo game as a kid, and I am so delighted to find a game that draws direct inspiration from that game, and improves on it in a modern context. It feels like the best parts of Wario Land 4 plus the best parts of 2D sonic games, which is really the highest compliment I can give. The zany hand-drawn art style and incredible music are the cherry tomatoes on top of this magnificent pizza pie.

citations.review_text:
TL:DR; It takes a lot of work and skill to look like you don't give a ♥♥♥♥. The premier wario-like platformer bursting at the seams with style and frantic but refined gameplay.

Pizza Tower is so overwhelmingly loved by people its hard to say anything new. If you like high-speed platformers with a wickedly punky aesthetic and a killer soundtrack, you'll like this. A nice thing too is that it's entirely possible to beat the game and have fun without playing at a P-rank level constantly and darting around like a mayfly on cocaine, even though the game does more than welcome your attempts to play quickly and manically.

About the only thing I don't like about this game is the same I disliked with Anton Blast; the bosses don't gel well at all with the core gameplay and don't really act as a refreshing change of pace from normal play or an exit exam to prove you picked up what the game was putting down. They always felt like annoying roadblocks that in order to surpass you just learn the limited move sets by rota and then move on.

I did not enjoy this game, nothing wrong with it, just not for me. I prefer taking my time and exploring levels and this game is designed to race through each level in a certain amount of time. Stress inducing for me.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the soundtrack as high quality and fitting the game's style.

citations.review_text:
i ♥♥♥♥ with the aesthetic so much, it's just great
the gameplay is really fun and a pretty interesting take on platformers, it's obviously not the first ever game to think of "what if we made platformers really fast" but all the elements at play still add up to their own unique thing. it's overall paced very well, the bossfights imo kind of throw it off a bit but it's really not that bad and some of them are pretty fun in their own way too
the ost fits the style of the game incredibly well and is really good even on its own, and despite the game not really having any cohesive lore or in-depth storyline (most of it just operates on cartoon logic and whatever is currently comedically opportune) it still manages to end in a way that feels like a deserved, satisfying conclusion
the noise update also made the game even better to me, there are parts of the base game's movement i never particularly got fully comfortable with but the alternate movement of the noise just flows perfectly for me, i've 101%ed the game with it and it was a load of fun even though all-the-way-through game completions usually suck in one way or another
the level design is really charming and it's impressive how they made each level feel like its own little world while still making them add up to a cohesive experience rather than feeling like you're playing a rapid fire sequence of random ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥
it's also really easy to get into, there's no particularly strong backstory you have to immerse yourself in or an initial learning curve, you can just throw yourself at the first level and learn it on the job, the game mostly just consists of the levels and there isn't any story content
i do think the game could stand to be a bit harder but i'm probably biased because i've 101%ed it, but nevertheless a fantastic game

Such an heavy Birth and it was just really worth

This Game is in so many Ways beautiful. Soundtrack, Gameplay, Controls, Artstyle, Characters. I really regret not joining in in the Hype Train back in 2023 and only just now. 10/10. no Complains, not even about the very demanding P-Ranks <3

This game is genuinely awesome.

The artstyle is super fun and creative, the music is super catchy and the gameplay is top tier.

There isn't really much of a story but that's perfectly fine since the whole vibe of the game is goofy and cartoonish.

Every level feels like it's own little world with unique ideas, gimmicks, enemies and music and they're all equally amazing.

The movement is fast and satisfying once you get the hang of it and blasting through levels is really smooth since they're designed for speedrunning.

The bossfights are really well designed and fun with well telegraphed attacks and not a lot of rng (except for some pizzafaces I could mention).

I do have some minor issues but they really aren't much of a problem in general.

Overall an 8//10, what a great experience :D

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as fast-paced with movement mechanics that take practice to master but feel natural once learned.

citations.review_text: With the 355 hours I have on this game the adrenaline i feel when that banger soundtrack comes on during pizza time will not be matched by anything else, and the movement has become lobotomized into my skull as it is so hard yet when gotten down, so easy to use. I LOVE THIS GAME OH MY GOD

I've been mulling this review over for 3 years now, simply because I can't find the best words to describe my love for this game. I adore the art style, the humor is on point, the soundtrack is legendary. But most of all, the feeling of mastering the moveset of Peppino and the Noise as well as the levels and entering a flow state where one action fluidly leads into another, all culminating in seeing that JUICY P-Rank at the very end is like nothing else in the world to me.

What are you waiting for? Play Pizza Tower! It's a one of a kind experience.
Thank you Tour de Pizza, for making my favorite single player game of all time,

Pizza Tower might be my favorite game ever. 

I love platformers, but this is on another level; everything, the artstyle, the sound and music, the level design and mechanics, the player movement, the character design and expressiveness; it just clicks, at first, you might find yourself weirded out by how the game  works, as you might come from other platformers with "simpler" ideas, but once you get the hang of it, it all just comes natural. 

The adrenaline my surrenal gland released while playing this game was FELT. You can play the levels at your own pace, doing so is especially important if it's your first run through a level, but the REAL fun comes when, once you've mastered the level and got to know the level's layout; you go for your best run, aspiring for a P rank, the perfect run; nailing it down, or barely scraping through to get the rank you wanted, is the most fun ever.

Another thing I quite like are the challenges, checking off the achievements one by one and getting to know the game better than if you never had them to motivate you to do such stuff, gives the game quite a bit of replayability. The same thing goes for completition badges on your save files, playing the game a certain way will reward your save file with badges that made it worth for me to replay the game multiple times, improving my runs overall.

The length of the game itself is spot on, it doesn't drag for too long but isn't that short that you are left wanting more; even though, I'd really enjoy a sequel to this, even though I'm convinced it's practically impossible to recapture something like PIzza Tower is.

Overall, Pizza Tower is an amazing game, I advice anyone to try, even though platformers might not be your thing.

I can't believe the game about the fat italian guy who runs fast and screams real loud is the game that got me into art, writing, and other creative pursuits, this game is amazing because it excels in what it sets out to do; being a FUN GAME.

I feel like this game truly taps into that really powerful vein of what a ''cartoonish platformer'' should really feel like: going through wacky environments, running at high speeds with unstoppable force, powering through dumb chaos, and doing all of this as a character who's pretty much the straightman to everyone else.

This is my favorite game of all time, i've had games that i've played and enjoyed, sure, but i have never had a game that made me go: "♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, there should be more like this, there should be more games that understand what makes this one so good and DO more like it!!!"

i love Pizza Tower, and if there's anything to take away from this review, is to always support games that were made with heart.

I adore the art style, the humor is on point, the soundtrack is legendary. But most of all, the feeling of mastering the moveset of Peppino and the Noise as well as the levels and entering a flow state where one action fluidly leads into another, all culminating in seeing that JUICY P-Rank at the very end is like nothing else in the world to me.

What are you waiting for? Play Pizza Tower! It's a one of a kind experience.
Thank you Tour de Pizza, for making my favorite single player game of all time,
